# word coverage over 500 documents: 99.6% of served words of six letters or more appear in a unit of the same document
# baseline: brute-force substring scan over the same unit texts (grep-equivalent),
# so recall below is recall against what grep would find, in the same normalised case.
# caveat: recall@10 against a grep baseline measures ORDERING AGREEMENT where a query
# has far more than ten matches. Both orderings can be correct. Read the match counts.
